script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.startPlaying(true); g.hud.helpQueue = []; g.hud.helpT = 0.01; g.simulate(0.3); const L = g.layout; g.player.pos.set(L.xs[7].pos + 9, 0.15, L.zs[10].pos + 9); g.player.yaw = -Math.PI / 2 - 0.15; g.cam.yaw = -Math.PI / 2 - 0.15; g.cam.mode = 'near'; g.peds.prefill(g.player.pos, 22); g.simulate(0.3); const all = g.peds.list.filter((p) => !p.vehicle && !p.creature); const q = all.filter((p) => p.rig.extras).slice(0, 2); const p0 = g.player.pos, fx = Math.sin(g.cam.yaw), fz = Math.cos(g.cam.yaw); q.forEach((p, i) => { p.pos.set(p0.x + fx * (2.8 + i * 1.3) + fz * (0.9 - i * 1.6), 0.15, p0.z + fz * (2.8 + i * 1.3) - fx * (0.9 - i * 1.6)); p.state = 'idle'; p.idleT = 30; p.yaw = g.cam.yaw + Math.PI - 0.3; }); g.simulate(0.5); return { peds: all.length, enhanced: all.filter((p) => p.rig.extras).length, shown: q.length }; })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.cam.mode = 'mid'; const L = g.layout; g.player.pos.set(L.xs[7].pos + 9, 0.15, L.zs[10].pos + 9); g.cam.yaw = -Math.PI / 2 - 0.15; g.simulate(0.8); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2.0); const p = g.player.pos; g.peds.spawnCreature('hollow', p.x - 12, p.z - 2); g.peds.spawnCreature('hollow', p.x - 17, p.z + 3); g.simulate(1.2); return g.debugState(); })()
